authorization: User approved changing the four reviewed coin-purchase messages. This is a client-copy-only task, not authorization to change payment/account rules or deploy new production services.

copy.before: Please sign in before purchasing carrots.
copy.after: We couldn’t reconnect to your account. Please try again.
copy.condition: No internal session user before native coin checkout

copy.before: Carrot purchases are not enabled on this server yet.
copy.after: Coin purchases are temporarily unavailable. Please try again later.

copy.before: Payment is pending approval. Carrots will arrive after the store confirms it.
copy.after: Payment is pending approval. Coins will arrive after the store confirms it.
copy.condition: Native Pending/Deferred error or purchase-state pending callback

copy.before: Please finish your carrot purchase first.
copy.after: Please finish your coin purchase first.
copy.condition: Subscription checkout sees an active coin checkout before or after setup

implementation.exactPresentationMappings: The two new reconnect/unavailable sentences are explicitly preserved by user-error-message.ts, without broadening arbitrary diagnostic passthrough.

paymentFingerprint.protection: Both new coin-purchase sentences are counted, and reversing only those two sentences must recover the original frozen function hash. Other frozen IAP functions retain their exact hashes.

firstDomainRun.cause: The frozen purchaseSubscription body hash included the two user-approved changed sentences.
firstDomainRun.resolution: Updated the reviewed expected hash and added inverse-copy verification against the original frozen hash; no guard or assertion removed. Full gate rerun passed all 1252 cases.

unchanged: Guest/anonymous account eligibility and existing session checks
No new sign-in or account-binding flow
Server readiness, store billing, receipt verification and account ownership
Pending payment never grants coins before verified credit
Immutable receipt recovery, cancellation and committed-credit protection
Prices, wallet amounts, quotas and economic-domain isolation

release.clientAvailability: Reload Metro or use a separately published future client build.
release.note: Tests use actual controller/component code with isolated store/session fixtures; no claim of real store, all-device or production-user end-to-end acceptance. Counts overlap the domain gate.
